sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 1–28 — heading omitted from supplied source
sourceIssues.replacementLabel: plots the average number of weekday passengers
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: number 是中心名詞，使用 the average number of + 複數可數名詞。不能直接把複數 passengers 放在 number 前。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 1–28 — heading omitted from supplied source
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 表示乘客使用某條交通線路，用 passengers on a line。among 表示分布在一群事物之中，不能自然表達乘搭關係。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 1–28 — heading omitted from supplied source
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 起點和終點使用 from A to B。over 可接一整段時期，如 over the period 2000–2040，但不與兩個年份用 and 配對。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 1–28 — heading omitted from supplied source
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: with + 名詞詞組 + 現在分詞 可補充說明伴隨情況：with figures ... representing projections。represents 不能直接放在此結構中。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 1–28 — heading omitted from supplied source
sourceIssues.wrongLabel: both the Green as the Blue line follows an upwards trajectory
sourceIssues.replacementLabel: the Green and Blue lines follow upward trajectories
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 兩條線由 and 連接，中心名詞和動詞均用複數。放在名詞前修飾 trajectories 時用形容詞 upward，不用副詞 upwards。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 1–28 — heading omitted from supplied source
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 用顏色名稱加普通名詞 line 指圖中的特定數列時，通常使用 the。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 1–28 — heading omitted from supplied source
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 與 the Red line 相同，這裡指圖中已界定的 Yellow line。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 1–28 — heading omitted from supplied source
sourceIssues.wrongLabel: near to the broad stable average
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 表示數值在某個平均水平附近變動，用 around。broadly 是副詞，修飾形容詞 stable；首次提出的非特定平均值用 a。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 1–28 — heading omitted from supplied source
sourceIssues.replacementLabel: By the end of the period
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 固定時間結構是 by the end of the period，兩個單數名詞都由 the 限定。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 1–28 — heading omitted from supplied source
sourceIssues.replacementLabel: Green is expected to rank highest
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: Green 是被預測會達到某排名的數列，因此用 be expected to + 動詞原形。不能讓數列主動「expect」。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 1–28 — heading omitted from supplied source
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: passengers 是複數可數名詞，最高級數量用 the fewest。the least 通常修飾不可數名詞或程度。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 1–28 — heading omitted from supplied source
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 年份前使用 in。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 1–28 — heading omitted from supplied source
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: double + 名詞詞組 不使用 than。圖表中某數列的數值可寫 the figure for Green。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 1–28 — heading omitted from supplied source
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 代替已出現的單數名詞 figure 用 that；those 代替複數名詞。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 1–28 — heading omitted from supplied source
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 描述數列的起始水平，用 begin at + 數值。時間或地點起點才較常使用 from。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 1–28 — heading omitted from supplied source
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 逗號後的非限制性關係分句使用 which，不用 that。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 1–28 — heading omitted from supplied source
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 這裡比較的是兩條數列的水平，可寫 10,000 below Green。若用 fewer，要補出可數名詞：10,000 fewer passengers than Green。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 1–28 — heading omitted from supplied source
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 描述整段期間的發展，用 over the next five years。next five years 前需要 the。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 1–28 — heading omitted from supplied source
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 動詞 climbed 由副詞 gradually 修飾；終點數值由 to 引出。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 1–28 — heading omitted from supplied source
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: virtually 是副詞，修飾形容詞 unchanged。virtual 不能直接作程度副詞。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 1–28 — heading omitted from supplied source
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: stand/remain at + 數值；若數值是約數，around 放在數值前：at around 50,000。單獨寫 around 50,000 也正確。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 1–28 — heading omitted from supplied source
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 省略與主句相同的主語時，before 後用動名詞 rebounding。回升的終點使用 to，不用 into。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 1–28 — heading omitted from supplied source
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 數值在兩個水平之間來回變化，用 oscillate between A and B。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 1–28 — heading omitted from supplied source
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 表示情況遍及整個十年，用 throughout the first decade。序數詞前使用 the。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 1–28 — heading omitted from supplied source
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 補充說明該段的平均值，可用現在分詞 averaging。修飾數值要用副詞 approximately。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 1–28 — heading omitted from supplied source
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: peak 在這裡是不及物動詞，數列自行達到高點，所以用主動完成分詞 Having peaked，不用被動式。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 1–28 — heading omitted from supplied source
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 修飾動作 fell 要用副詞 steadily。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 1–28 — heading omitted from supplied source
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: maintain 是及物動詞，直接接賓語：maintain its upward course，不加 on。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 29–55 — Convergence, rates, plateaus and relative change
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 表示在同一整段期間內，用 over the same period。same 前需要 the。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 29–55 — Convergence, rates, plateaus and relative change
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 逗號後用現在分詞補充前述走勢的結果：reaching 105,000。直接使用過去式會形成逗號拼接。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 29–55 — Convergence, rates, plateaus and relative change
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 這裡指剛才已識別的 Green 和 Red 兩條數列，因此使用 the。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 29–55 — Convergence, rates, plateaus and relative change
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 表示兩條數列逐漸接近並相遇，用 converge。meet themselves 錯誤使用反身代名詞。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 29–55 — Convergence, rates, plateaus and relative change
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: level 在這裡是形容詞，表示兩者處於相同水平：be level at + 數值。levelled 表示被弄平或使數值穩定。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 29–55 — Convergence, rates, plateaus and relative change
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 一般過去式描述 2010 年以後的走勢，用 after 2010。since 2010 通常要求延續至現在的完成時語境。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 29–55 — Convergence, rates, plateaus and relative change
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 數據增長速度使用 grow at an average rate。speed 較常描述實際移動速度。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 29–55 — Convergence, rates, plateaus and relative change
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 表示每年的平均數量，用 per year 或 a year。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 29–55 — Convergence, rates, plateaus and relative change
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 名詞 total 後面用 of 引出總數：a total of 100,000。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 29–55 — Convergence, rates, plateaus and relative change
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 被代替的是單數 total，因此用 that。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 29–55 — Convergence, rates, plateaus and relative change
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 年份前使用 in。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 29–55 — Convergence, rates, plateaus and relative change
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: experience 後面直接接名詞詞組。形容暫時的急升，用複合形容詞 short-lived 修飾 surge。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 29–55 — Convergence, rates, plateaus and relative change
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 表示一個走勢之後出現另一走勢，用 be followed by + 名詞。dip 是可數事件名詞。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 29–55 — Convergence, rates, plateaus and relative change
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: dip to + 數值 表示下降後到達的水平。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 29–55 — Convergence, rates, plateaus and relative change
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 兩個年份界定的時期使用 between A and B。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 29–55 — Convergence, rates, plateaus and relative change
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: edge up 表示小幅上升；終點數值用 to。upwards 不能取代片語動詞中的粒子 up。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 29–55 — Convergence, rates, plateaus and relative change
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 名詞 plateau 的水平由 at + 數值 引出。動詞形式為 plateaued at 100,000。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 29–55 — Convergence, rates, plateaus and relative change
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: further 可修飾下降程度；furthermore 是句子連接副詞，表示「此外」。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 29–55 — Convergence, rates, plateaus and relative change
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: hover around + 單一水平 表示數值在該水平附近徘徊。between 需要兩個端點。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 29–55 — Convergence, rates, plateaus and relative change
sourceIssues.wrongLabel: gap of the highest to lowest lines
sourceIssues.replacementLabel: gap between the highest and lowest lines
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 兩個比較項目的差距使用 gap between A and B。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 29–55 — Convergence, rates, plateaus and relative change
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: narrow by + 數值 表示差距縮小的幅度。narrow to 則表示縮小後的差距。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 29–55 — Convergence, rates, plateaus and relative change
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 以 2000 年作基準，可用過去分詞短語 compared with 2000。in comparison with 2000 也是正確替代。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 29–55 — Convergence, rates, plateaus and relative change
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 固定表達是複數 in relative terms，表示按比例而非絕對數值比較。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 29–55 — Convergence, rates, plateaus and relative change
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 數據增至兩倍時直接用 double。double up 可表示彎下身體、共用房間或兼任工作，意思不同。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 29–55 — Convergence, rates, plateaus and relative change
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 修飾比例短語 over half 要用副詞 slightly。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 29–55 — Convergence, rates, plateaus and relative change
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 修飾數字和倍數用副詞 approximately。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 29–55 — Convergence, rates, plateaus and relative change
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 倍數 + that of + 比較對象 中，times 後面不加入額外的 of。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 56–80 — Forecasts and projected comparisons
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 圖表或預測資料表示某結論時，通常用一般現在式 suggest。進行式會不自然地把它當作暫時活動。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 56–80 — Forecasts and projected comparisons
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: continue 可接動名詞 continue rising，或接不定詞 continue to rise；不能混合為 to rising。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 56–80 — Forecasts and projected comparisons
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: Blue 是被預測的數列，不是作出預測的主體，所以用 be forecast to + 動詞原形。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 56–80 — Forecasts and projected comparisons
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: resume 表示恢復某項活動時，通常接名詞或動名詞：resume growth／resume growing。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 56–80 — Forecasts and projected comparisons
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 年份前使用 in。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 56–80 — Forecasts and projected comparisons
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 動詞 peak 用 at 引出最高數值。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 56–80 — Forecasts and projected comparisons
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: Red 是被預期呈現某走勢的數列，使用被動預測結構。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 56–80 — Forecasts and projected comparisons
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 表示跌至最低點後停止下降，使用 bottom out at + 數值。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 56–80 — Forecasts and projected comparisons
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: remain 是連繫動詞，後面接形容詞 stable，不用名詞 stability。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 56–80 — Forecasts and projected comparisons
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 數列是被預測上升的對象，用 be projected to + 動詞原形。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 56–80 — Forecasts and projected comparisons
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 修飾上升動作用副詞 modestly。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 56–80 — Forecasts and projected comparisons
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 逗號後用現在分詞補充上升後仍處於最低位置的結果。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 56–80 — Forecasts and projected comparisons
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 根據已記錄圖表資料，Yellow 低於其餘三條線，因此用 all the other series。若原圖只顯示它低於一條線，不能自動作此修改。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 56–80 — Forecasts and projected comparisons
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: although 後面接完整有限分句；despite 後面接名詞或動名詞。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 56–80 — Forecasts and projected comparisons
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 先行詞是多條 lines，因此用複數所有格 their。respective 表示各條線各自的增長率。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 56–80 — Forecasts and projected comparisons
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 修飾動詞 differ 要用副詞 considerably。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 56–80 — Forecasts and projected comparisons
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: be expected 後面接 to + 動詞原形。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 56–80 — Forecasts and projected comparisons
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: Green 的增量是被拿來與其他數值比較，因此用過去分詞 compared with。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 56–80 — Forecasts and projected comparisons
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 圖表中屬於某數列的數字用 figure/value for + 數列。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 56–80 — Forecasts and projected comparisons
sourceIssues.wrongLabel: The projected figure for Green and Blue
sourceIssues.replacementLabel: The projected figures for Green and Blue
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: Green 和 Blue 各有一個預測數值，因此中心名詞用複數 figures。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 56–80 — Forecasts and projected comparisons
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 短形容詞 close 通常用 -er 形成比較級：closer。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 56–80 — Forecasts and projected comparisons
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 前面指兩個複數 figures，所以代詞使用 those。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 56–80 — Forecasts and projected comparisons
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 年份前使用 in。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 56–80 — Forecasts and projected comparisons
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 表示構成某個比例，用 account for + 比例／部分。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 56–80 — Forecasts and projected comparisons
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 一般比例表達通常寫 half of。a half of 在把 half 當作明確分數單位時也可能合文法，因此不宜設成絕對自動修改。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 81–104 — Averages, crossover language and advanced summaries
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: passenger total 屬於特定的 Green line，用所有格 the Green line's；passenger 放在 total 前作單數名詞修飾語。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 81–104 — Averages, crossover language and advanced summaries
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 表示平均而言，固定表達是 on average，不用 the。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 81–104 — Averages, crossover language and advanced summaries
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 表示綜合計算四條線的數據，用 across the four lines。between 較適合兩者之間的關係。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 81–104 — Averages, crossover language and advanced summaries
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 表示每條線的平均乘客數，用 per line。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 81–104 — Averages, crossover language and advanced summaries
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 已提供明確預測終點，使用 rise to。towards 只表示朝某水平發展，未必到達。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 81–104 — Averages, crossover language and advanced summaries
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 圖表是被整體考慮的對象，因此使用過去分詞 Taken；固定短語包含冠詞 a。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 81–104 — Averages, crossover language and advanced summaries
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 這裡指題目中唯一且已識別的圖表，因此用 the graph。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 81–104 — Averages, crossover language and advanced summaries
sourceIssues.wrongLabel: both an expansion as a redistribution
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: both 的配對連接詞是 and。兩個抽象不可數概念在這裡可使用零冠詞。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 81–104 — Averages, crossover language and advanced summaries
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 表示主導地位由一條線轉至另一條線，用 shift from A to B。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 81–104 — Averages, crossover language and advanced summaries
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: close the gap 表示消除或縮小差距。close up 常表示商店關門、傷口閉合或靠攏。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 81–104 — Averages, crossover language and advanced summaries
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 表示某事件首次發生，用 first。firstly 通常用於列舉論點。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 81–104 — Averages, crossover language and advanced summaries
sourceIssues.wrongLabel: drew at same level than Red
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 表示一條數列追至與另一條相同水平，用固定搭配 draw level with。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 81–104 — Averages, crossover language and advanced summaries
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: after which 可建立非限制性關係分句，指「在該次持平之後」。after that 可另起主句，但原句需要正確連接。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 81–104 — Averages, crossover language and advanced summaries
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: behind 作介詞時直接接比較對象，不加 than。若使用比較級，可寫 lower than Green。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 81–104 — Averages, crossover language and advanced summaries
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 後面是完整有限分句，所以用 although。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 81–104 — Averages, crossover language and advanced summaries
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: contract to + 數值 表示收窄後的最終差距。contract by 可表示縮小幅度。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 81–104 — Averages, crossover language and advanced summaries
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: by 2040 表示到該年時差距已收窄至指定水平。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 81–104 — Averages, crossover language and advanced summaries
sourceIssues.wrongLabel: At none stage Yellow did overtake
sourceIssues.replacementLabel: At no stage did Yellow overtake
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 固定否定短語是 at no stage。它放在句首時，主句使用助動詞倒裝：did + 主語 + 動詞原形。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 81–104 — Averages, crossover language and advanced summaries
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 表示三條其餘數列中的任何另一條，用 another + 單數名詞。the other 通常指兩者中餘下的一個。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 81–104 — Averages, crossover language and advanced summaries
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 表示數列最後一個數據點，慣用複合名詞是單字 endpoint。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 81–104 — Averages, crossover language and advanced summaries
sourceIssues.explanationZhHantHk: 短形容詞 high 用 -er 形成比較級：higher。

sourceIssues.pedagogicalBand: Issues 81–104 — Averages, crossover language and advanced summaries

sourceControls.correctExample: The graph plots passenger numbers on four lines. The passengers were distributed among four stations.
sourceControls.boundaryZhHantHk: on 表示使用線路；among 可表示分布於多個地點。

sourceControls.correctExample: The period was from 2000 to 2040, or between 2000 and 2040.
sourceControls.boundaryZhHantHk: from–to 和 between–and 均正確，但不可混合。

sourceControls.correctExample: Figures after 2025 represent projections. The graph includes figures after 2025, with those figures representing projections.
sourceControls.boundaryZhHantHk: 完整主句使用 represent；with + 名詞 + 分詞 使用 representing。

sourceControls.correctExample: Both Green and Blue follow upward trajectories. The lines move upwards.
sourceControls.boundaryZhHantHk: 名詞前用 upward；單獨修飾移動方向可用 upwards。

sourceControls.correctExample: Green ranked highest and carried the most passengers. Red carried the fewest passengers and the least traffic overall.
sourceControls.boundaryZhHantHk: fewest 修飾複數可數名詞；least 可修飾不可數概念。

sourceControls.correctExample: Blue began at 50,000. The analysis began with Blue.
sourceControls.boundaryZhHantHk: 數值起點用 at；內容次序可用 begin with。

sourceControls.correctExample: Blue began at 50,000, which was below Green. The line that began at 50,000 was Blue.
sourceControls.boundaryZhHantHk: 非限制性逗號分句用 which；限制性分句可用 that。

sourceControls.correctExample: Green climbed gradually to 75,000, remaining at around that level thereafter.
sourceControls.boundaryZhHantHk: 終點用 to；近似靜態水平可用 at around。

sourceControls.correctExample: Red rebounded by 5,000 to 115,000.
sourceControls.boundaryZhHantHk: by 表示回升幅度；to 表示回升終點。

sourceControls.correctExample: Yellow oscillated between 28,000 and 35,000 but hovered around 32,000 on average.
sourceControls.boundaryZhHantHk: 兩端範圍用 between–and；單一中心水平用 around。

sourceControls.correctExample: Having peaked at 115,000, Red declined. Red was pushed to a peak by a temporary event.
sourceControls.boundaryZhHantHk: 數列自行達峰用主動式；外力令其達峰時可有被動分析。

sourceControls.correctExample: Green maintained its course. Green remained on an upward course.
sourceControls.boundaryZhHantHk: maintain 直接接賓語；remain 可與 on 介詞短語配合。

sourceControls.correctExample: The lines converged at 95,000 and were level with each other.
sourceControls.boundaryZhHantHk: converge 不用反身代名詞；level 可接 with 或 at。

sourceControls.correctExample: Ridership grew at 5,000 passengers per year, representing an average annual increase of 5,000.
sourceControls.boundaryZhHantHk: 動詞搭配 at a rate of；單位搭配 per year。

sourceControls.correctExample: Yellow experienced a surge. Yellow surged to 45,000.
sourceControls.boundaryZhHantHk: 名詞框架和動詞框架均正確，不可混合。

sourceControls.correctExample: Blue reached a plateau at 100,000, or plateaued at 100,000.
sourceControls.boundaryZhHantHk: 名詞和動詞兩種框架均可接受。

sourceControls.correctExample: The gap narrowed by 10,000 to 5,000.
sourceControls.boundaryZhHantHk: by 表示縮小幅度；to 表示最終差距。

sourceControls.correctExample: Green doubled, but the two passengers doubled up in one room.
sourceControls.boundaryZhHantHk: double 表示數值變成兩倍；double up 有其他詞彙意思。

sourceControls.correctExample: The figure was 3.3 times that of Yellow and approximately three times as high as Yellow's.
sourceControls.boundaryZhHantHk: 兩種正確倍數框架。

sourceControls.correctExample: Blue is forecast to resume growing. The analysts forecast that Blue will resume growing.
sourceControls.boundaryZhHantHk: 數列作主語時用被動；分析者作主語時用主動 forecast。

sourceControls.correctExample: Red bottomed out at 60,000 and remained stable. The analysts identified the bottom at 60,000.
sourceControls.boundaryZhHantHk: 片語動詞和名詞 bottom 的不同結構。

sourceControls.correctExample: Although all lines grew, their rates differed. Despite growth on all lines, their rates differed.
sourceControls.boundaryZhHantHk: although 接有限分句；despite 接名詞詞組。

sourceControls.correctExample: Green added 30,000 passengers, compared with 40,000 for Blue.
sourceControls.boundaryZhHantHk: 分詞比較結構與 figure for a series。

sourceControls.correctExample: The figures became closer together, and each line moved closer to the other.
sourceControls.boundaryZhHantHk: closer together 和 closer to each other 都正確。

sourceControls.correctExample: Red accounted for half of Green's total. Exactly a half of the sample was selected.
sourceControls.boundaryZhHantHk: 一般比例多用 half；把 half 當明確分數單位時 a half 可能成立。

sourceControls.correctExample: On average, each line carried 65,000 passengers per year.
sourceControls.boundaryZhHantHk: on average 不加 the；率使用 per。

sourceControls.correctExample: Taken as a whole, the graph shows expansion. Taking the graph as a whole, the analyst identified expansion.
sourceControls.boundaryZhHantHk: 無明示執行者用被動分詞；有明示主語可用主動分詞。

sourceControls.correctExample: Green drew level with Red, after which it moved ahead. Green reached the same level as Red.
sourceControls.boundaryZhHantHk: 片語搭配和一般比較框架都正確。

sourceControls.correctExample: Blue remained behind Green but was 5,000 lower than Green.
sourceControls.boundaryZhHantHk: behind 直接接對象；比較級 lower 使用 than。

sourceControls.correctExample: At no stage did Yellow lead. Yellow did not lead at any stage.
sourceControls.boundaryZhHantHk: 句首否定短語需要倒裝；普通語序不需要。

sourceControls.correctExample: None of the series is expected to reverse. None of the series are expected to reverse.
sourceControls.boundaryZhHantHk: none of 可配單數或複數動詞；選擇取決於把群組視為整體還是多個成員。
